test: Stone Crook adds pack-configured drops when breaking dirt

environment.isolation: fresh HORIZON_HOME, HORIZON_LAUNCHER_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; audio disabled

steps: Loaded API 0.5 module with vanilla-hooks capability; startup reported one running mod and no load error.
Placed a stone platform, gave the player ftbsbc:stone_crook, and selected it in survival.
Broke minecraft:dirt at 0,101,1 with the crook.
scope_limit: Only one dirt break was exercised. This validates the hook, tool context, vanilla-drop preservation, and cap of two outputs, but not vanilla RNG parity, every crook recipe, damage/durability, or the original implementation's interpretation of max.
